newsitem.title: USA: LanOptics sees return to profitability.
newsitem.headline: LanOptics sees return to profitability.

text.p: LanOptics Ltd Chairman, Eli Fruchter, said he expects the company's increased market-building activities and R&D spending to propel the company's return to profitability later this year.

Fruchter said that the first quarter results were in line with the company's plans and that new products have shown a significant impact on the gross profit. The company reported a loss of $998,000 for the first quarter of 1997 ended March 31.
LanOptics develops, manufactures and markets networking solutions and Internet applications.
